clauses.title: Scope– Requirements for Unplasticized Polyvinyl
clauses.text: 1. Scope- Requirements for Unplasticized Polyvinyl chloride (upvc) injection  moulded  fittings for jointing with solvent cement or elastomeric sealing ring to the UPVC pipes for soil and waste discharge system for inside and out side building including ventilation and rain water  system covered in IS 13592 : 1992*.

clauses.title: Type of
clauses.text: 2. Type of  Fittings - Fitting shall be of one of the following types : a) tee (87. 5o ), Wye (45o) single, double (cross) or reducing, with or   without   inspection doors; b) Bend, with or without inspection  doors (87.5o,45o and 22½o); c) Reducer ; d) Coupler; e) Socket plug ; f) Cleansing pipe; g) Adaptor (for connecting UPVC pipes to other materials); h) Vent cowl; j) Pipe clip; and k) Waste trap with strainer (Nahani trap with Jali).

clauses.title: Size Designation
clauses.text: 3. Size Designation —  Shall be designated by the diameters of their sockets. The nominal inside diameter of the  fitting shall correspond to the nominal outside diameter of the pipes given in IS 13592 : 1992.

clauses.title: Colour
clauses.text: 4. Colour  of  Fittings-  Shall  be uniform dark shade of grey.

clauses.title: Materials – Shall consist
clauses.text: 5. Materials - Shall consist essentially of polyvinyl chloride , to which may be added only those additive that are needed to facilitate  the   manufacture of sound and  durable  fittings of good surface finish , mechanical strength  and opacity under conditions of use , together with such pigments as are necessary to meet the requirements of 4.The material shall contain not   less than 2.5 percent by mass of titanium  dioxide. The addition of the manufacturer's own clean rework material produced during manufacturer and work testing, complying with this  standard is permissible upto 10 percent .

Workmanship — Both the inner and outer surface of the fitting shall be cleanly finished, smooth and free from grooving, blistering or other deleterious defects, when viewed without magnification. Each end of the fitting shall be square to the axis of the approximate line. 9. Requirements

clauses.title: Sockets of fittings shall
clauses.text: 9.1  Sockets of fittings shall be either of solvent cement type or rubber ring type.

clauses.title: Socket and Spigot Configurations
clauses.text: 9.2  Socket and Spigot Configurations — A fitting shall have any of the following configrations of socket and spigot. a) Asolvent cement type of socket at each  end of the fittings; b) A rubber ring type of socket at each end of  fitting; c) A solvent cement type socket at one or  two  ends, and a spigot at the other end,   or at  each of the other ends  ( as applicable) of   the fitting; d) A rubber ring type socket at one or two  ends,   and a spigot at the other end, or at  each of   the other ends (as applicable) of  the fittings;  and e) A solvent cement type socket at one or two   ends, and a rubber  ring Type socket at the other   end, or at each of the other nds (asapplicable)   of the fitting.

clauses.text: 9.3 Access Openings— When so required, fittings shall be supplied with an access opening, with threaded caps. clauses.title: Physical Test Requirements
clauses.text: 10. Physical Test Requirements

clauses.title: Visual Appearance
clauses.text: 10.1 Visual Appearance — The internal and external surfaces of fittings shall be smooth and clean, and free roovings and other defects. The ends shall be clean and shall be square with the exisof the appropriate line.

clauses.title: Stress Relief Test
clauses.text: 10.2 Stress Relief Test— Shall not show blisters, excessive delamination or cracking or signs of weld line splitting.

clauses.title: Vicat Softening Temperature
clauses.text: 10.3 Vicat Softening Temperature —Shall not be less than 78oC

clauses.title: Resistance to Sulphuric Acid
clauses.text: 11. Resistance to Sulphuric Acid — The mass of the specimen  shall neither increase by more than 0.32 g not decrease by more than 0.13 g.

clauses.title: Sulphated Ash Content
clauses.text: 12. Sulphated Ash Content —Not more than 10 oercent by mass.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties
clauses.text: 13. Mechanical Properties

clauses.title: Impact Test (Drop Test)
clauses.text: 13.1 Impact Test (Drop Test) — Shall not fracture or crack through its complete wall thickness.

clauses.title: Water Tightness of Joint
clauses.text: 14.  Water Tightness of Joint —  Assembly of fitting with the pipe shall show no leakage.

clauses.title: Titanium Dioxide Content
clauses.text: 15. Titanium Dioxide Content— Shall not be less than 2.5 percent by mass. Note - For methods of tests refer to Appendices A to D of the standard and IS 6307 : 1985 Rigid PVC sheets and IS 12235 : 1986 Methods of test for unplasticized PVC pipes for potable water supplies Part 6 Stress  relef test:  Part 7 resistance to Sulphuric acid. For detailed information, refer to IS  14735 :1999 Specification for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (UPVC) injection moulded fittings for soil and waste discharge system for inside and outside buildings including ventilation and rain water system.
